caseName: Hart v. Selected Investments Trust Fund
caseNameFull: Hart v. Selected Investments Trust Fund, Linwood O. Neal, Trustee
attorneys: George Zolotar for petitioners., George E. Soule, James D. Fellers and Luther Bqhanon for Harrison, respondent., Solicitor General Rankin, Thomas G. Meeker, David Ferber and Arthur Blasberg, Jr. for the Securities and Exchange Commission in opposition.

opinions.text: Motion to substitute W. M. Harrison as a party respondent in the place of Paul C. Duncan, resigned, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied.
